summary: Comprehensive testing completed for Semoyo Joyo B2B E-Commerce + Mini ERP. All backend APIs (55/55 tests) and frontend features tested successfully. Key features: Piutang (accounts receivable), Expenses module, RBAC (admin vs owner), Settings (staff/store/customers/sync), stealth admin access, and checkout form updates.

minor_issues.issue: Stock-in expense not immediately visible in expenses list (possible timing/caching issue)
minor_issues.impact: Expense is created but may not appear in same-request query
minor_issues.note: Backend test passed, expense creation works, but immediate retrieval in same test run didn't find it

passed_tests: ✅ Health check and basic endpoints (home, payment config, store profile)
✅ Authentication (admin/admin123, owner/owner123)
✅ Piutang flow: checkout with 'piutang' method, order status, SJ- prefix, payment instructions
✅ Piutang settlement: POST /admin/orders/{id}/settle, status changes to 'paid', paid_at set
✅ Piutang validation: cannot simulate payment on piutang orders, cannot settle twice
✅ Receivables API: GET /admin/receivables with total, count, by_customer, orders list
✅ Expenses CRUD: create (201), read, update, delete (owner-only)
✅ Expenses validation: amount 0 rejected (422), future date rejected (400)
✅ Expenses categories: 8 categories returned
✅ Stock-in with expense: POST /admin/stock/{id}/adjust with expense_amount creates expense
✅ RBAC: admin blocked from staff/customers/sync/store/reports/audit (403)
✅ RBAC: owner has access to all owner-only endpoints (200)
✅ Staff management: list, update credentials, create new admin, delete admin, cannot delete owner
✅ Staff validation: wrong owner password rejected (403), duplicate username rejected (400)
✅ Store profile: update, public endpoint hides bank details
✅ Customers analytics: total, regular, new, with_receivables, segment data
✅ Data sync: POST /admin/settings/sync with 6 checks, snapshot, idempotent
✅ Dashboard consistency: owner has finance fields, admin has limited data
✅ Reports: sales report with expenses and net_profit_after_expenses
✅ Export: Excel and PDF exports work (200)
✅ Credentials still work after all operations (admin/admin123, owner/owner123)
✅ Frontend: NO admin portal banner/button (stealth mode)
✅ Frontend: Stealth admin link (tiny lock icon) in footer links to /rahasia-admin
✅ Frontend: /admin redirects to / when not logged in
✅ Frontend: /rahasia-admin shows login form
✅ Frontend: Admin login successful, redirects to /admin/dashboard
✅ Frontend: Admin sidebar has Piutang, Pengeluaran but NOT Laporan/Audit Log/Pengaturan
✅ Frontend: Admin dashboard does NOT have finance section
✅ Frontend: Checkout form label 'Nama / Nama usaha' with no placeholder
✅ Frontend: Piutang payment method available with notice
✅ Frontend: Submit button text changes to 'Buat Pesanan (Bayar Nanti)' for piutang
✅ Frontend: Owner login successful
✅ Frontend: Owner sidebar has Laporan, Audit Log, Pengaturan (owner-only)
✅ Frontend: Owner dashboard has finance KPI cards (expenses, net profit)
✅ Frontend: Settings page has 4 tabs (Akun, Toko, Pelanggan, Sinkronisasi)
✅ Frontend: Staff table, store profile fields, customers analytics all present
✅ Frontend: Sync tab shows status, checks, snapshot
✅ Frontend: Laporan page has expenses and net profit KPIs
✅ Frontend: Stock-in dialog has expense box with amount input
